text:
maria-partners: Quick Q — CloudPartnerX changed their usage webhook payloads. They now send 'compute_units' and 'op_count' but billing expects 'inference_tokens' and 'requests'. Do we have a canonical metric mapping we can share or should we ask them to publish a transform? cc @james-billing @kevin-eng

james-billing: We don't have one universal canonical mapping across all partners. We maintain partner-specific adapters that declare: partner_metric -> canonical_metric + multiplier + unit. We should document an agreed mapping schema and required fields (multiplier, aggregation_window, dedup_strategy).

kevin-eng: +1. Also need to know semantics (is compute_units per-second, per-call, cumulative?). If partner batches hourly vs per-call that affects aggregation. Can we get a sample payload?

maria-partners: Pasting a sanitized example they sent: ```json
{
  "partner_customer_id": "abcd-1234",
  "events": [
    {"ts":"2026-03-10T14:02:00Z","metric":"compute_units","value":1200},
    {"ts":"2026-03-10T14:02:00Z","metric":"op_count","value":3}
  ],
  "batch_id": "batch-9988"
}
``` They said compute_units ~ GPU seconds, op_count ~ API calls.

helena-sre: Operational notes: require timestamps in ISO8601 UTC and include event_received_ts on our side. For late-arriving batches we need partner_batch_origin_ts and their timezone. Also recommend batch_id + per-event dedup_key to avoid double-ingestion.

pat-security: Security note: partner_customer_id must be a reversible identifier only when using a partner-specific contract. Prefer hashed customer id in the webhook and exchange a mapping over the secure onboarding channel. Also confirm sender certs and HMAC header for integrity.

james-billing: Proposal for normalization record (fields we expect in adapter config):
- partner_metric_name
- canonical_metric_name
- multiplier_to_billing_unit (float)
- unit (string)
- aggregation_window_sec (int)
- dedup_key_fields (list)
- liability_owner ("partner"|"redwood")
- rounding ("floor"|"ceil"|"nearest")

maria-partners: Partners asked about "liability_owner" — they want partner to absorb small retries under 5% and Redwood to cover systemic mismatch. Can we encode that as a label so later finance adjustments are automated?

kevin-eng: We can add an optional 'liability_policy' freeform string and a numeric threshold field 'auto_offset_threshold_pct'. Implementation idea: connector computes normalized_amount = value * multiplier, then compares delta vs expected and flags if > threshold.

meter-bot: Automated check: When connector receives a batch without dedup_key_fields it will tag event with "needs_human_review" and increment partner_bad_batch_counter.

james-billing: Action items:
- @kevin-eng: add normalization schema + example YAML in partnerships repo (ETA EOD tomorrow)
- @maria-partners: request partner to provide a 48-hour sample payload and confirm timezone + HMAC headers
- @pat-security: share onboarding checklist for hashed ids + cert thumbprint exchange
- @helena-sre: define monitoring alert for partner_bad_batch_counter > 5 in 1h

maria-partners: Thanks — I'll ping partner and ask for sample. I'll also include a short onboarding doc template for mapping. If we can get their 48h sample by Tuesday we can run reconciliation tests mid-week. :thumbsup:

kevin-eng: I'll start a draft mapping YAML here and link back. Example snippet we'll publish in repo:
```yaml
partner: cloudpartnerx
mappings:
  - partner_metric: compute_units
    canonical: inference_tokens
    multiplier: 1.0
    unit: gpu_seconds
    aggregation_window_sec: 3600
    dedup_key_fields: [batch_id, ts]
    auto_offset_threshold_pct: 5
```

maria-partners: perfect — will follow up after partner sends sample. tagging this thread for handoff to solutions-engineering once mapping is stable.

james-billing: One more: we should log original partner metric & raw payload into the ledger for auditability (read-only) — helps with disputes.

pat-security: +1 on ledger, ensure access control on that ledger and retention policy.

maria-partners: Great, I'll update partner status doc and close when we have sample + YAML mapping.

kevin-eng: noted. I'll create the PR template for connector mappings so future partners follow same schema.

meter-bot: Reminder scheduled: run partner-mapping-health-check on 2026-03-12 09:00 UTC.
